policies.geometry: The approved V2040 silhouette, opening count, opening order, proportions, wall density, base and depth remain immutable across finish and context.
policies.crop: No derivative may crop the product silhouette. Mobile artboards use contain until a separately approved mobile master exists.
policies.proof: Generated media creates desire and supports commerce. It never proves manufacturing, origin, workshop, artisan, customer ownership, press coverage or measured colour.
policies.material: A continuous low-sheen mineral-feel surface is represented digitally. Commercial material claims remain gated by H-009 and H-010.
